stage.quote: Today, I'm excited to announce that CodeSandbox has joined Together AI!
stage.note: CodeSandbox was acquired by / merged into Together AI in Dec 2024 (announced by founder Ives van Hoorne as 'joined Together AI', widely reported as an acquisition, e.g. HN thread titled 'CodeSandbox Acquired by Together AI'). Prior to that it had raised a priced seed and Series A as an independent startup; those are recorded below for history.

total_funding_usd.basis: sum of confirmed seed ($2.4M, 2019) + Series A ($12.7M, 2020) per CodeSandbox's own blog posts; no further priced rounds reported before the Dec 2024 Together AI acquisition (deal terms undisclosed)
total_funding_usd.quote: we've raised a new round of $12.7 million Series A funding, led by EQT Ventures

last_round.quote: we've raised a new round of $12.7 million Series A funding, led by EQT Ventures. With participation from existing investors, Kleiner Perkins, Arches Capital, and Vercel founder Guillermo Rauch accompanied by new angels Andreas Blixt and Daniel Gebler.

note: CodeSandbox (founded 2017 by Ives van Hoorne, Amsterdam/Netherlands) was acquired by / merged into Together AI in December 2024; the CodeSandbox product and team continue operating (per the announcement, 'CodeSandbox will continue to run as normal'), and CodeSandbox SDK (this card's product) launched as part of that deal to provide sandboxed code execution for Together AI's generative-AI customers. Funding figures above (seed + Series A, totaling $15.1M) predate the acquisition and were raised while CodeSandbox was an independent startup; acquisition price was not disclosed. Buyers should treat CodeSandbox SDK's backing as that of Together AI (a well-funded AI cloud/inference company), not as a standalone startup's balance sheet.
